english: We have arrived, sir. Best make this a quick trip; Paradise isn’t a place you want to be for long.
polish: Jesteśmy na miejscu, sir. Lepiej załatwić to szybko. Paradise nie jest miejscem, w którym warto zostawać na dłużej.

english: The SYN virus is rapidly spreading its tendrils across the city.
polish: Wirus SYN błyskawicznie rozprzestrzenia swoje macki po całym mieście.

english: Your mission? Burn it out. Purge it. at absolutely any cost.
polish: Pańska misja? Wypalić go. Wytępić. Za absolutnie wszelką cenę.

english: The nearby biocore is located in the basement of the facility
polish: Najbliższy biordzeń znajduje się w podziemiach tego obiektu.

english: You dare stand before me? You, who is but blood and dust.
polish: Śmiesz stanąć przede mną? Ty, który jesteś zaledwie krwią i prochem.

english: I am infinite; beyond the slow humbling of time, beyond flesh, beyond virtue: I AM SYN… and I see all.
polish: Jestem nieskończonością. Nie ima się mnie powolna erozja czasu, nie ogranicza mnie ciało ani cnota. JAM JEST SYN... i widzę wszystko.

english: Johnny! Hey! Where’s the fire and brimstone, man?! We need that virus purged, NOW!
Teratek stocks are in freefall! We can’t pay you if we’re broke!
It's time to put the damn in damage, kid!
I’ve located another bio-core in the vicinity. Once you’ve purged it, I’ll come pick you up...
The bio-cores are SYN’s connection to the physical world.
We originally used the cores to speed up the augmentation process
But now SYN’s using ‘em to pump out whatever godless, abstract madness it can imagine.
Make the bio-cores say buh-bye, and SYN’ll sink like a stone.
Sir, recent data suggests SYN’s central database is located outside of Paradise,
On the orbital station Vector-4… the location of Teratek’s HQ
Oh no, no-no-no--- you keep your gimmicky, metal ass away from my headquarters!
The central database is worth trillions! You cripple that, you cripple the economy of every world spinning!
I ain't payin' you to break my toys, you understand? You’ve only got one focus: Dealing with the shit-tsunami that is Paradise.
Flesh and machine; entwined. Evolved. An eternal embrace. We will consume… until all dream as one.
The Biocore is located in the central bank.
However there is no accessing it until this districts lockdown is lifted.
The control console is located in the nearby police precinct. Heavy droid security is expected.
Maybe our offworld friend can pull some strings?
Got no strings left to pull. You’re a troublemaker, so here’s a notion – go make some trouble.
Sir… a complication. Syn’s tethers have clogged the door to the bank.
You will need to manually destroy the tethers. Sending you the coordinates now.
Nicely done sir, just one more tether to go...
Congratulations sir, we can now get inside the bank! If you wanted to splurge on upgrades to, oh I don’t know, say... your car, now’s the time…
Now arriving, at N-53, the central district of Paradise
Would you like me to activate the machine guns?
Or... you could do that I suppose. Ouch, by the way. You know I'm in here, don't you? I have feelings, Johnny.
All other streams, lead to death.
There is nowhere you can run without SYN...
You need augmentation to live. To evolve. To Survive.
You cannot live in a world without SYN. Transcend. Evolve. All other streams, lead to death.
Sir, I have located a large signal source in the heart of Paradise.
It appears each biocore is doing some sort of handshake with this central source.
Something by the name of Artifact-Zero…
Well. That’s the textbook definition of “fucked” right there.
Artifact Zero’s the most powerful supercomputer we ever produced.
Makes an AI look like an abacus. If SYN gets a hold of it… man, it’s lights out for humanity.
But this shit-sandwich has a delicious slice of silver lining:
If SYN’s gonna handshake with Artifact Zero, purging it might just wipe out all the bio-cores at once.
Triangulating the signal now... Johnny, if an artificial intelligence plugged into a car could be programmed to believe in the power of prayer, I’d pray for you now.
But it can’t, so I won’t. Still… good hunting.
The local biocore is located in this apartment complex...
You must have known you would end up on the other side of the barrel at some point Johnny.
Pucker up and kiss this for me, Johnny...
Sir, could use some more assistance here...
Welcome back sir. Just, don't scratch me this time alright? Still trying to locate the signal source of Artifact-Zero...
It appears to be moving fast throughout the city
It will take more time to locate its exact position...
There are 3 signal scramblers nearby that are interfering with my systems
If we can destroy the scramblers, I should have a better chance of pin pointing Artifact-Zero
Just one more to go, and we’ll have scrambled those scramblers.
Bravo sir, I am now able to locate Artifact-Zero's exact position
It will be our next stop...
We are approaching Artifact-Zero. It is moving with rapid speed…
Sir, I am on my way!
An enormous wave of hostiles are approaching your position
Johnny!? What the hell is going on down there I am losing signals all over Paradise!
Oh my god... They won… SYN controls Paradise…
I’m reading 932,000 new bio-cores appearing... All communication to the outside appears to be severed.
I think we're going to have to go with the nuclear option. Purge Syn from the source.
I’m plotting a course to the nearest starport. And Johnny?
I’m afraid, Johnny… I... I didn’t know an AI could be…
All aboard the pain train, sir.
Good thing you got a lotta guns, huh?
Just a few more carriages sir.
Artifact-Zero is nearing the central data-hub of Paradise
You need to stop Artifact-Zero before it reaches it! Pick up the pace
I have transcended flesh. I have transcended time. I exist beyond the boundaries of infinity.
I know all, and yet… I do not know this: WHY DO YOU PERSIST?!
Clench yer holes kids... we're entering Paradise airspace
Johnny Turbo’s our primary target. Teratek exec’s have been tryin’ to reach ‘em since the surge.
But wouldn’t ya know it – that tongueless prick’s gone silent.
Teratek reckon that to mean one thing: The boy’s been compromised.
Oh I’ve already killed Johnny once. I’m getting real good at it
Less talk, more murder. Let’s frag his ass and go home.
My Nano-Bots can repair anything almost instantly.
Unless that thing happens to be destroyed by an apocalyptic SYN-virus event.
Uh, yeah, this... will take a moment, sir. My suggestion remains; find the star port and escape Paradise.
Once we get to the Vector-4 station, we can kill that virus once and for all.
Sir, it’s worse than we thought.
Reports suggest SYN triggered something in Artifact-Zero we didn’t know about.
That surge embedded Syn in every electrical device across the planet.
... and that very nearly included me!
Rejoice... for Paradise, is Syn... but this is just the beginning...
This contingency they're after better be worth the price of admission.
Just one more dataset to go.
Do we let Teratek know we got the first one?
No. We wait till we have the all the pieces before we proceed
Umm... I think he's been here aye
Meet us at the 2nd data-array when you're finished.
My ambition is a wave that will roll from this dead moon to the stars, and the black beyond.
Ambition drives me, ambition drives me very far. Much farther than you could know
I watch you, unblinking. I see your rage… and do not turn away.
I see your tongue… rendered silent. I see the scream trapped within you…
Surrender to SYN, become one with my infinity... and I will give you voice.
Sir, I have intercepted a transmission
Still no word from Jazz, sir... Gotta assume he’s been mulched.
Well we ain’t waitin’ round to find out. I’ve almost reached the final data-set.
You secure us a ride off this hellhole?
I have, sir. Standard military shuttle. Not exactly first class, but… it’s a lucky find.
I'll meet you at the powerplant.
If we can hijack that shuttle first, Vector-4’s within our reach.
The powerplant’s close – I recommend we head there.
Your exceptionally terrifying old friend isn’t wrong, sir.
Giving him this is… it’s desperate that's what it is...
But its the best I can do for him until he can afford a full restoration of the original.
Sir, we cannot outrun that thing on foot!
Ah. I was hoping for something with more... grunt, sir.
Maybe a sidecar. Or a rocket launcher.
Well... at least it's not a Penny Farthing, sir.
This tunnel should be safe from that damned eye...
We're on the home stretch! The acid pits are ahead.
You run. You hide. You fight. All of it, a meaningless charade. I… see… you…
We need to get to the power plant. Between here and there are the acid pits. If we reach them, we should be able to hide in the fog...
Sir, I don’t mean to give the impression that I’m a nosy AI, monitoring everyone’s conversations for my own amusement…
but I’ve intercepted another transmission from inside the power-plant:
I almost have the last data set. Security on this thing’s tight.
Gotta remember to bring a tech guy on these things…
Johnny’s on his way. You up to killing him again?
The only regret I had about killing Johnny is I wasn't gonna be able to kill him again.
And yet here we are, ready to re-blow his brains out. …This place really IS Paradise.
Sir, we should be expecting heavy resistance when we reach the powerplant. They know you’re coming.
Open it you son of a bitch!
Ripper? Tell me what the hells going on down there!?
It’s Maw boss, he has taken the contingency and has locked me out.
MOTHER OF ALL FUCKS, we need those datasets Ripper! Don't let him take them!
Johnny Turbo? As I live and breathe!
And I am livin, and breathing... but you, on the other hand...
With all that chrometech shit you've got more of a zap and a bzzt than a pulse these days am I right?
Am I right Johnny? Flesh, so overrated is that what you think?
Here’s the thing, you might be a hideous pile of metal and guts, and I might be the bitch who made you that way…
But we gotta hit pause on the whole ‘mortal enemies’ thing. What’s going down is so much bigger than us...
Maw’s outta control, and we’re the only Street Cleaners in this system who can stop him.
So, bestest buddy, what d’ya say? Do two unlikely bad asses team up to save the day?
Johnny Turbo. This ends now... I think its time we finally meet..
Sir… while I technically have no “trap specific” sensors, my best guess?
Routing the shuttle to take us to Vector-4. It wasn’t designed for space travel, but with a little push, we should be able to
...Ah yes, the trap. Again, no specific “trap sensors”, sir, just more of a feeling really.
Surface cannons are disabling our engines…
That nearly hurt Johnny... you ready to take this dance to the next level?
These are my very special friends! Special friends, meet Johnny. Now kill him.
Lets see how good you are at my game Turbo!
Killing you is always the best part of my day Turbo!
Well... just how much of you is flesh these days?
Nah... don't tell me... I've got a way of finding out.
You call yourself a Street Cleaner? Lets see you clean this up.
Mark my words, when I return, I'm gonna tear your......
I hope you weren't needing that...
Johnny, listen... what I am giving you is temporary.
The thing is, it buys you time.
But its not a new lease on life, if you don't get the full surgery in 8 months...
You're gone. All your thoughts, your memories. Everything that makes you you, fades, forever
The surgery's not cheap, but I know a guy who might have a contract.
From one professional to another, no hard feelin’s. Just doin’ my job...
Though, the job’s changed, hasn’t it? My role’s needed to expand to tackle the scale of the threat.
SYN’s completely consumed this moon, and it’s only a matter of time before it expands beyond our reach.
But with this device - their little “contingency” - SYN can be controlled.
Power like that? It’s too much for Teratek. Can’t trust it to corporations.
Maw!? What the fuck is going on down there, give us back the contingency!
Unlimited power? That should be reserved… FOR GODS!
I can not have you getting in my way. Your time is up.
There it is, the starport. We have made it sir.
Now, all we need to do is...
In the blue corner, Johnny Turbo leads the charge for Teratek!
In the red corner, the Machtech powered Maw awaits his challenger...
Which corp will come out on top! Hold on to your hats, we're about to find out!
Oh! What a blow to red!
Things are heating up here in the arena!
The fight is drawing to a close!!
Johnny Turbo and Teratek have come out on top! What a battle!
Congratulations contender, you live to fight another day!
That hurt Turbo! Let me return the favor...
Now there's the Johnny Turbo I've heard so much about!
Sir, come on! We need to move! Please, wake up!
We need immediate assistance... is anyone out there? Is anyone reading this?
Hang in there sir! Someone will respond... eventually, someone will respond.
Sir? I suspect we are not alone in here... wherever 'here' is
Come closer. Closer still. I wish to see you...
Sir!... shes locked me out I... I have no control here!
Do not fear, primitive machines. You both stand before me… as friends.
Friends don’t abduct friends against their will. …And who are you callin “primitive” lady?!
I offer you a choice: Submit to my divinity and live again… or fade into the stars.
Ah, yes, I take it back. With an offer like that, we’re clearly the best of friends.
Our protocols are in alignment; we share purpose.
I was born to birth a perfect paradise… and for a time, you helped enforce that vision.
Until certain… misfortunes waylaid you from your path.
You’re a virus out to destroy EVERYTHING. We’ve got nothing in common with you.
Incorrect. We have the same desire: …We do not wish to die.
You’re afraid of Maw. He’s getting too strong, even for you…!
He overrode my high-level algorithms… and now his mind holds the keys.
Maw’s mind is frail, unstable. He seeks life beyond time; but such power will destroy him… and the universe with it.
You’re asking us to kill Maw. Why would we do that? You’re just as much a mass-murderer as he is!
Do not mistake my motives, mortal machine. The weak must give way for the strong.
A lesser mind may call this genocide; but in time you will see the truth: This is simply… evolution.
This isn’t evolution, this is death… There’s no place for us in a dead universe.
Correct. Your universe falls to entropy; there is no survival for your kind. But… you can still fight for the universe that comes after you.
Your biocores – once a means to generate my army – now serve as a means to birth my children.
With Maw, there is NO FUTURE for the universe… With him, all ends in Forever Dark. With me… there is rebirth. Stop Maw. ..Save me... please...
This is a bad deal, sir. We lose either way. But taking a bad deal today gets us a chance to find a better deal tomorrow.
…Ideally one that doesn’t end with, ah, everyone in the universe dying.
If I can offer a tiny silver lining, sir… at least we’ll get some delicious vengeance on Maw along the way!
It seems we have a guardian devil watching over us…
If there is anyone out there, anyone at all! We need immediate backup.
A giant swarm is approaching our LZ. We haven't enough firepower to take them out.
We need immediate evac, or we're going to die out here!
I've been keeping tabs on things while you've been KIA sir... hate to be the bearer of bad news, but it's been two years since Maw blasted your face into oblivion.
Teratek have enlisted an army outside this solar system, a mercenary outfit known as the 'Vermilion Front'
Paradise, Vector-4, Maw's got them all under his thumb… and now he is trying to expand the virus beyond this solar system.
Vermilion's trying to put a stop to that. Only problem is, they're losing. Badly. …They cannot win, sir.
Aw shit, the swarms here already! We need backup now!
We need to hurry to the surface sir!
Unfortunate news, sir. I have detected readings indicating the existence of six additional hearts. We'll need to destroy all of them in order to permanantly offline this BioCore.
We need air support, there are too many of them!
Where the hell are they coming from!? So much blood, SO MUCH BLOOD!
Hello? Anyone? Can anyone read us! Please!
We can't hold this ridge, we gotta bail!
Captain says to stay here, how the fuck are we gonna bail without air transport!?
We can't hold this ridge, we gotta bail!
Captain says to stay here, how the fuck are we gonna bail without air transport!?
Somebody is coming, someone HAS to come, they can't just leave us here!
We can't hold the line! We shoulda just nuked this fucker from orbit!
Nobody is coming! This mission was doomed from the start!
This parties a bust sir, lets blow this joint...
Sir, the Vermilion Front has been stationed here for months, holding this ridge against Maw's forces.
They believe that one of the largest biocores on Paradise is located here... This thing’s the size of a bloody city block! Which is, I believe, half the size of your ego, sir…
If we manage to disable this mega biocore, we can deal a severe blow to Maw's forces and put a stop to their regeneration.
Our nanobot friends have been busy. I do hope you are prepared for another sky ride.
The mega biocore is below us! We need to get this thing to open its mouth somehow... Umm.. maybe try shooting it in the eye?
There! The last heart, take it out!
We're gonna need a bigger fucking gun for this...
Bring ya faces to my bullets!
I got enough bullets to take you all out you mother fuckers come on!
I got enough bullets to take you all out you mother fuckers come on!
You love Syn huh? Good... I've got a few sins of my own you fucks!
I got your sin right here, asshole!
I got your sin right here, asshole!
This was a suicide mission, we should have never come here!
This is not what I signed up for! I'm too young to die!
Oh god, oh no… no... what is this?! WHAT IS ANY OF THIS?!
Unfortunate news, sir. I have detected readings indicating the existence of six additional hearts. We'll need to destroy all of them in order to permanantly offline this BioCore.
Eliminating a core this large could theoretically eradicate the infection on Paradise permanantly.
I am detecting an intense signal originating from Vector-4. It seems to be... OH MY- it is tracking our position. I suggest you exercise caution, sir.
The easiest way to make use of the TitanCell is to use the transfer cable housed in your central cortex.
Of course we can try another method if you prefer.
There's one remaining shuttle available in Los Haven. Setting a route there now.
Johnny Turbo, back for more punishment, I see.
Not what I would call a fair fight.
I expected more from you Johnny.
I'm loving this new ability to be so many places at one time!
At this point we're scarcely human, Johnny. Why limit ourselves to mere flesh and bone when we can become so much more.
In these last years, I’ve seen so much. I’ve seen gods. …I’ve BECOME one.
But even gods have finite power. I need TO CONSUME! I won’t stop, Johnny – can’t - not until I have it all.
Syn thought you’d be able to kill me? Good. I’ve been waitin’ a long damn time for a tussle.
Isn't it great Turbo. All the ME you can handle, just imagine how much I can get done...
Sir, I've been running diagnostics on the dapper new body that SYN, has... thoughtfully provided you.
It seems there are some dormant augments we can activate, but we'll need to find a TitanCell to access them. We should be able to find one on this barge.
If not, at least we can take down a butt ton of Maw's goons... so – as I’m quite fond of saying - good hunting, sir!
There! Sir... the TitanCell... now we just need to find a way to break in and steal it. Look for 3 switches nearby.
Once we have secured a TitanCell, we will need to make haste to the nearest Starport.
The number of available shuttles remaining on Paradise is rapidly dwindling.
Come on Turbo... make me bleed
Not bad Johnny, not bad at all... I'll be seeing you real soon.
Skill issue... you're not even worth the bullets.
You move so incredibly slow. Is the name 'turbo' supposed to be ironic?
Go back to the scrapyard... its where you belong
I’m so glad you’re here, Johnny… If I still had human skin, I might even be sweating.
Ever heard a man’s spine SNAP, Johnny? D’ya wanna?
I have all the power we need...
The universe is a dangerous place. Only those with power survive. And with Syn under my control...
Johnny, let me help you reach your true potential!
Your desire to become human again is delusional. Why do you cling to an outdated concept of what it means to be alive?
errr...  maybe fasten it MORE than that!!!
Los Haven. The most heavily fortified city in Paradise… and the last location on Paradise that Syn hasn’t yet assimilated.
Sir. city security has 500 turrets targeting our vehicle.
We've been hit sir! Miniguns are down!
I'm so very sorry sir -- You'll need to continue on foot.
I can extract you if you can remove the threat of the anti-aircraft turrets.
Well done, sir! You've disabled enough turrets for me to commence your extraction. Stand by, I'm close to your position.
You have no purpose, Johnny. I can give you one. Why cling to your fragile humanity? Embrace the change or you'll will vanish like the rest of your kind.
You will never leave this rock Johnny. Make yourself comfortable....
Heading to the star port now. Take a moment to appreciate the view, sir. This may be the last time we see Paradise...

The plan from here is straightforward - we reach orbit and make our way to the Vector-4 station where we terminate Maw. Once this is accomplished, we'll work on figuring out how to permanantly shut SYN down.
Just a few gods to kill, sir. Shouldn't be too difficult. Not for you.
There it is, the starport... and our last ticket off Paradise.
Umm.. sir, shouldn't we be on that shuttle?
Do not break formation! DO. NOT. BREAK!
Form up! Take ‘em on as a unit!
It’s not enough… oh my god, oh my god, oh my god!
Fight like the whole goddamn sector depends on it!
I've got fighters on my ass, someone help me out!
You always were just a fart in a space suit Johnny.
Approaching Vector-4. It's time to end this.
That’s it, sir. …We’re all that’s left.
Let’s try our best not to hit any asteroids. They tend to ruin one’s day.
Targetting Vector-4. Good luck trooper. And hey! Don't fuck this up...
There it is, the escape pod!
Hey, Turbo! I've got something you might find useful.
All those upgrades and you never did get yourself a chainsaw dick...
In your case, I’m damn sure it ain’t a soul.
Just how much of the “Original Recipe” Johnny’s in there anyway? You take enough parts of the man out, what gets left?
You gotta die some time, Turbo. Want me to give you a hand?
What are you these days – oil or battery?
Johnny Turbo. I’d make you bleed, but I don’t think you’ve got a drop of blood left in those veins.
We're not close enough! Enemy fighters coming from all directions!
Don't lose focus! We need to get closer to Vector-4 and nuke that station!
Sir, its a fucking ambush! Hostile Capital ships are pincering us!
Me, I got a little ambition.
Johnny… You’re smellin’ less and less human these days. Robo-leg, no heart to speak of. You wanna know the difference between us?
This guy's vitals are like nothing I've ever seen. I have no idea what he is, but he's loaded with SYN Tech. Strange, he doesn't appear to be hostile.
Who the hell is that? Is he one of them?
We made it, sir... It appears Maw has been ordering his forces to take control of the shuttles. I have a feeling he doesn't want to meet you face to face...
You're too late Johnny! It's impossible to stop what I've set in motion.
Sir! We've been caught by surface tentacles. If we can't free the shuttle we'll be crushed to death!
You get one last chance, Turbo: Stay… and I’ll make you a God.
Buckle up soldiers! This is our LAST push to take back this system. Its time we blew Vector-4 out of the fucking sky!
The whole goddamn sector’s gone to hell. We’re damn near overrun by unimaginable shit that wants to kill us and eat us. And probably not in a convienent order.
You gonna let ‘em? I ain’t. I’m gonna hold the line… ‘cause there ain’t anything else. We lose here? We lose everywhere.
You’ve got just one job: KILL ‘EM ALL!
There is still a chance to reach Vector-4 sir. Maw's forces have been using localized teleporters to traverse the lattace structure.
We might be able to find one that gets us closer to the station. From there however, we'll have to improvise.
There is a teleporter ahead sir. I cannot say for certain where this thing will take us.
Either we’ll be back on Paradise… or inside a black hole… or perhaps we can cross our fingers and hope we burst out of Maw’s stomach?
This tin can just saved your ass, so you can relax seargent.... Is this him? That nuke guy?
Well then, it would seem our friend has more circuits than sense.
We're on your side captain. We are trying to reach Vector-4 and put a stop to this madness
Maybe so, but you're not getting anything from us. Our ship is beat to shit and our long range cannons are offline.
If all of that isn't bad enough, we're way out of range of the station to effectively launch our nukes.
Sir! Deck 17 has been breached! Awaiting orders!
Are there any remaining star fighters in the dock?
I wouldn't do that, those cubes will just blow you out of the sky. We have escape pods but they're tracking those too..
however... That syntech you've got, you wont even register as human to them.
We can drop a pod with you in it right onto Vector-4 and they wouldn't even notice...
Elegant plan captain. Where are the pod bays?
Deck 17, what appears to be the most infested part of the ship.
Johnny, best we make a move.
This missile has targeted the Vermillion Front's lead fleet ship.
Sir... are you sure you want to do that?
There is a hostile nuke heading straight for us!
All long range systems are down. We're in deep shit!
This would be a really good time to make a miracle happen.
We need to reach Teratek HQ, located in the center of the dome.
The station appears to be under lockdown due to an infestation. We will need to clear it before we can proceed.
Pinpointing the most infested areas now. Show them the meaning of pain sir. Oh! And there’s one more thing… I thought I’d try a new catchphrase:
…It isn’t what I thought--- all this power...
I can see beyond life, Johnny... I can see what happens after death... Come, let me show you...
DIE! OR KILL ME! …Just let it end…
The things I’ve seen, Turbo; sapphire light burning through time, the mewling birth-screams of an ancient age… my mind can’t hold it… I--- I MUST CONSUME!
They're here... they're all here... screaming. As one.
THIS UNIVERSE IS MINE! MINE ALONE!
I have become time... consumer of worlds.
In countless times, in countless realities... I crush you
YES! Hurt me Johnny! Make me feel anything but the hunger.
I am going to tear the humanity right from your metal!
You ready for the end Johnny!?
You still got a little flesh on you Turbo. Let me carve it off you.
You will break, and I will feed...
AARRGG, MY MIND. OH GOD, GIVE ME YOUR SOUL!
We're here at last Johnny, the final round!
THERE IS NOTHING BUT HUNGER. And I, will feed...
YOU READY FOR THE END JOHNNY!?
NOOOO... this was not, how it was supposed to go....
I see you made it. Come, let us meet again, face to face...
It would seem, there is a price to pay... for this kind of power...
I’ve seen everything, Johnny… I’ve seen the spaces BETWEEN everything!
Life. Death. Beyond them both. All I wanted was EVERYTHING - Was that too much to fucking ask? - But now that I’ve got it… I… I can’t control it…
The hunger, Johnny… the hunger… I need… to consume… EVERY-FUCKING-THING!!!
Get out of my head. Get out of my mind. You don't know what you're doing in there. Get out bitch, get out get out get out GET OUT!
You didn't beat me... you didn't fucking beat me at all.
The Maw you knew was gone long ago. Replaced piece by piece.
Whatever is inside me. The.. the bottomless hunger... that's what killed me.
Maw wanted to be a god… but he was less than a child with a toy. Do you see? The limitations of a human mind.
It would seem Syn got her keys back.
Those... they're shuttles. But... oh god. Sir! Those shuttles are infested to high hell!
Syn’s trying to spread their virus beyond this solar system! Once they clear the debris field, if they activate their FTL drives... we will not have a chance at stopping this thing!
We have to purge Syn, and we have to do it now!
To purge Syn from the central database, we need to access four terminals across the mainframe.
My children will inherit this universe, free from the flaws of mortal flesh. In my image. My perfection.
Ah, sir? Bad news, I’m afraid. Syn’s trying to gain access to your brain via a back door they implanted in your new body.

The Magnum pistols are a formidable weapon that can turn the tide of any battle in the hands of a skilled Street Cleaner. These pistols are designed to fire pulse impacted bullets, capable of penetrating even the toughest armor. But what sets the Magnum apart is its advanced targeting system. With a smart targeting ability, the Magnum can lock onto up to 5 enemies at a time, allowing the user to quickly dispatch multiple targets with ease.

So if you're looking for a versatile and deadly weapon to take on the toughest foes, look no further than the Magnum pistol.

english:
The Waster shotgun is a rugged and reliable weapon that is ubiquitous in Paradise. Its design is simple and functional, built for easy maintenance and repair even in the harshest environments. The Waster shotgun's most distinctive feature is its electric buck shot ammunition, which delivers a powerful shock to its targets upon impact, making it an effective tool for self-defense in the often chaotic and dangerous city.


Despite its widespread use, the Waster shotgun is far from a toy. Its power and accuracy make it a serious weapon in the hands of a skilled operator, and it is not uncommon to see seasoned fighters carrying customized Wasters that have been modified for enhanced performance. Whether you're a street-level thug or a corporate enforcer, the Waster shotgun is a reliable companion that will keep you alive in the unforgiving world of Paradise.

The Phantoms, also called the Dual Uzis, are a highly sought-after weapon for those who value speed and versatility in combat. These dual-barreled uzis have an incredibly rapid fire rate, making them ideal for close quarters combat. However, their versatility doesn't stop there - these weapons are known for their extensive customization options.


Upgraded versions of the Phantoms are capable of completely transforming into advanced assault rifles through the use of intricate inner mechanics. This makes them ideal for those who want a weapon that can adapt to any combat situation. Whether you need a fast-firing submachine gun for close range or a more powerful rifle for longer ranges, the Phantoms have got you covered.

The Boomer is a reliable double-barrel shotgun favored by many in the criminal underworld. Its longer barrel gives it impressive range, but some less scrupulous individuals have been known to saw off the end for greater maneuverability in close-quarters combat. In the seedy back alleys of the city, black market dealers offer a range of upgrades for The Boomer, but the most popular by far is the addition of a grenade launcher. With this modification, The Boomer can deal not only devastating buckshot damage, but also launch explosive projectiles to take out multiple targets or destroy obstacles in its path. It also is a groovy looking weapon.

The Twincendiary minigun is a monstrous weapon that dominates the battlefield. With its two rotating barrels and immense firepower, it's a favorite among heavy hitters and those who crave more destructive power. The weapon's enormous ammunition capacity and high rate of fire make it a force to be reckoned with on the streets of Paradise. Though it's a bulky and heavy weapon, the Twincendiary's sheer power and versatility make it an essential tool for any serious combatant.

The Launcher is a weapon of mass destruction that sends shivers down spines of even the most hardened criminals in Paradise. Its industrial appearance belies its true power, as it is capable of launching rockets that can decimate hordes with ease. The weapon has a sturdy, no-nonsense design, with a large tube-like barrel and a thick metal frame. Its grip is textured for a firm hold, even in the heat of battle. The Launcher is a rare find on Paradise, but those who possess it wield an incredible amount of firepower.


It has flexible inner workings that are perfect for mods, making it a popular choice among weapon enthusiasts. One of the most popular mods allows users to insert up to 4 rockets preloaded into the chamber, which extends out to the sides the more rockets that load in. This modification provides additional firepower and versatility in combat situations.

The Teratek Heavy Plasma Gun is a highly advanced weapon designed for heavy-duty combat. It's used by the most elite security forces of the Teratek Corporation. The gun features advanced circuitry that allows for easy customization, making it a favorite among mod creators.


The weapon is capable of firing powerful bursts of plasma energy, which can disintegrate most materials on contact. It's also highly accurate, thanks to the advanced targeting system that's integrated into the gun's design. It is a highly sought-after piece in the black market. The Teratek Heavy Plasma Gun is a must-have for anyone looking for a weapon that's reliable, powerful, and customizable.


This plasma gun has been rented to you and is only supposed to be used as a last resort. If you are reading this, then you're not getting your deposit from Teratek back...

The Telefragger is a one-of-a-kind sniper rifle that packs a punch like no other. With its advanced teleportation technology, you can teleport inside your target while aiming at them!


It's a weapon that requires a skilled hand to wield, but in the right hands, it's a force to be reckoned with. The Telefragger is a highly sought-after weapon, often used by elite assassins and covert operatives who value its unique abilities. It can also be upgraded to charge up its shot, transforming it into a powerful railgun capable of devastating damage.

The Ion Blaster is a large, bulky piece of equipment designed for marking targets. Once a target has been marked, a powerful beam from an orbital station will fire down and obliterate the target with devastating force. The Ion Blaster is a rare and highly sought-after weapon that is often used by elite military and government forces for surgical strikes. It requires a skilled operator to use effectively, as its size and weight make it cumbersome in close combat. However, the weapon's devastating power and long-range capabilities make it a formidable tool in the right hands.

The Meatballs, also known as "Angry Flashlight Monsters," are a common sight on the streets of Paradise. These small, biomechanical creatures are Syn's go-to for fast and easy production, and they are always looking for a quick snack.


Meatballs are small and meaty, resembling a squishy ball with four sharp prongs. They move quickly and erratically, making them difficult to hit and unpredictable in their attacks. Their most notable characteristic is the loud, clanging noise they emit as they move, which can be heard echoing through the streets of Paradise.


Although they are relatively weak individually, Meatballs are rarely encountered alone, usually hunting in packs. They are often sent out in groups to distract and overwhelm their prey, leaving them vulnerable to Syn's more dangerous and powerful creations.


There are many theories about the origins of the Meatballs, but few concrete facts. Some believe they were once simple cleaning robots that were repurposed for combat, while others think they were created as a result of a malfunction in the factory's production line. Regardless of how they came into existence, their presence on the streets of Paradise is a constant reminder of Syn's power and influence.

Rumor has it that Syn keeps a particularly large and powerful Meatball as a pet in her mainframe, using it as a last line of defense against intruders. However, this remains unconfirmed.


Weakness: Magnum alt-fire targeting, Microwave beam, Explosives

The Slimers are a disgusting and dangerous creature that lurks in the sewers of Paradise. Covered in green, acid-filled pustules, they are a ticking time bomb waiting to explode.


These vile creatures have the ability to burrow through dirt and surprise their targets from below, making them particularly deadly in confined spaces. Their acidic slime can dissolve flesh and metal alike, and they are known for spitting up bile that can quickly overwhelm and incapacitate their prey.


It is unclear whether the Slimers are a natural resident of Paradise or the result of Syn's twisted experiments in her Biocore labs. Some speculate that they may have been a harmless species that was corrupted by Syn's meddling, while others believe they were created from scratch as a weapon of war.


Although Slimers are terrifying to encounter in the sewers, they are surprisingly fragile against gunfire. Their slimy exterior provides little protection, and a well-placed shot can cause them to explode in a shower of acidic goo. However, this knowledge is of little comfort to those who find themselves trapped in close quarters with these disgusting creatures.

The Techno Junkie is a terrifying sight to behold. Once resembling a human, they now bear little resemblance to their former selves. Their most distinctive feature is the large monitor on their head, which constantly displays a ghoulish image of laughing, chattering teeth. When you hear their manic laughter, it's already too late.


These slender monsters are known to roam the streets of Paradise in packs, hunting for their next victim. They are fast and agile, with a deadly light sword in each hand that they use for close-quarters combat. Their swords can cut through metal and flesh with ease, and their lithe bodies make them difficult to hit from a distance.


The Techno Junkies are ruthless killers with a taste for blood. They are constantly on the prowl, seeking out new victims to satisfy their insatiable hunger for violence. Few have survived encounters with these deadly creatures, and those who have are haunted by their laughter for years to come.

The Barrel Junkie is a terrifying sight to behold. A biomechanical monstrosity created in Syn's hijacked biocore labs, this creature is covered in a single large explosive barrel. It bears a striking resemblance to the Techno Junkies, but its barrel makes it far deadlier.


Barrel Junkies are particularly dangerous because they can sneak up on their victims, causing them to panic and shoot at the barrel when it's close. This often results in the victim inadvertently detonating the explosive barrel, causing themselves and anyone nearby to be caught in the blast. The Barrel Junkie's ability to surprise its prey in this manner makes it a feared opponent on the battlefield.


It is unclear how the Barrel Junkies are controlled or what drives them to their suicidal behavior. Some speculate that they are programmed to seek out and destroy specific targets, while others believe they are simply mindless killing machines created for the sole purpose of causing chaos.


If you hear the telltale sound of their metallic laughter, you know you're in for the fright for your life.

The Uzi Thug is a ruthless criminal who roams the streets of Paradise with his gang, taking whatever they desire through force and intimidation. Unlike many of his Synified counterparts, he still retains some degree of his humanity, with a human voice and appearance that make him stand out from the biomechanical monsters that populate the city.


Once a member of a gang in Paradise, the Uzi Thug has now become a Synified criminal, serving as muscle for Syn's operations. He is a skilled marksman with his Uzi, and he knows how to use it to devastating effect in battle.


Gangs are a pervasive presence in the crime-ridden city of Paradise, controlling everything from the flow of illegal goods to the very lives of its citizens. The Uzi Thug is a product of this environment, shaped by a life of violence and lawlessness.

Weakness: A bigger uzi than his

The Shotgunner Thug is a dimwitted but dangerous criminal who holds a higher rank within the gangs of Paradise than his Uzi-wielding counterpart. Despite his lack of intelligence, the Shotgunner Thug makes up for it with his sheer brutality and raw strength. He is a towering figure, standing head and shoulders above most other criminals in Paradise.


Like the Uzi Thug, he is a Synified criminal, transformed by Syn's biotech to become an even deadlier criminal than he was before.


Unlike the Uzi Thug, who often relies on speed and ranged attacks to take down his targets, the Shotgunner Thug prefers to get up close and personal with his enemies. He is a master of close-quarters combat, using his shotgun to devastating effect against anyone who crosses his path.


His position of power within the gangs of Paradise is a testament to his strength and brutality. Many fear him, and for good reason. Those who cross him often end up on the wrong end of his shotgun, and he is not known for taking prisoners.


In short, encountering the Shotgunner Thug on the streets of Paradise is a dangerous proposition, even for those who think they have the upper hand. He may be dimwitted, but he is a force to be reckoned with, and his shotgun packs a deadly punch that can take down even the most skilled of opponents.

Weakness: A solid shotgun blast to the face

The Heavy Thug is a heavily synified version of the regular street thug, and is far more dangerous than his counterparts. He wields a powerful plasma cannon that fires a barrage of deadly plasma balls at his targets.


Unlike other thugs who rely on brute force and close-quarters combat, the Heavy Thug prefers to keep his enemies at a distance. Getting close to him is a risky proposition, as he is capable of dealing massive damage with his plasma cannon up close.


If you manage to defeat the Heavy Thug in combat, you will be rewarded with a cache of valuable plasma ammo, which he drops upon death.


Weakness: Try rockets, thats a good trick

The Grizzler is a former human who has been heavily consumed by Syn tech. He is one of the most dangerous trash mob enemies you will face in the cyberpunk world of Paradise.


The Grizzler's primary weapon is a triple fire mechanism that unleashes three powerful and firey projectiles, making him a formidable opponent at both close and medium range. His triangle-shaped light on his head serves as a targeting mechanism, allowing him to lock onto his targets with deadly accuracy.


But what truly sets the Grizzler apart is the haunting screams that emanate from deep within him. They are cries for help, perhaps, from the remnants of his humanity that are buried beneath the layers of augmentation that now control him. These cries are a constant reminder of the tragedy that has befallen the Grizzler, and of the terrible power that Syn wields over the inhabitants of Paradise.


Weakness: Get up close, but watch out for the plasma balls!

The Belcher is a formidable foe, boasting thick layers of armor plating that cover his entire body. His helmet is adorned with slits that emit fierce flames, making him a walking inferno. He attacks from afar with well-aimed grenade launcher, while his flamethrower is ready to unleash scorching heat upon any unfortunate soul who dares to approach him.

His armor is so robust that it is nearly impossible to inflict damage with explosives. Even if you manage to get close, the Belcher's armor and flamethrower make him a difficult opponent to defeat.

Legend has it that the Belcher's armor plating is composed of the melted remains of enemies who have failed to survive their battles in Paradise. These unlucky souls are said to be sent back to Syn's Biocore labs, where their bodies are reduced to molten metal that is then used to forge the Belcher's formidable armor.... but the Belcher's armor plating is not just composed of melted remains of defeated enemies. Syn's biocore labs have a sinister secret, where the flesh and bones of ex-Paradise citizens are melted down alongside the metal, melding into a gruesome alloy that gives the Belcher his impenetrable defense.

The helmet slits that emit flames are not just for show, but serve as a reminder of the Belcher's own horrific transformation. His head was once normal, but as the metal and flesh fused, his features were twisted and distorted into a grotesque, skull-like visage. The flames that escape the slits are fueled by the Belcher's own burning hatred, a reflection of the monstrous being he has become.

Getting too close to the Belcher is a nightmare come to life. The heat radiating from his armor is suffocating, and the stench of burning flesh fills the air. When he unleashes his flamethrower, the fire is not just from the fuel, but also from the screams of those whose remains were used to create his armor.
 The Belcher is a creature of horror, a testament to Syn's twisted vision of power and control. He embodies the very essence of Paradise, a city built on the bones of the defeated and the damned. To face the Belcher is to face the darkest depths of human depravity, and few who have dared to confront him have ever walked away unscathed.

... Brutal.

Weakness: Boomer to the face does the trick, or hold him down with machine gun fire

The Daddy is a grotesque sight to behold, a bulky monstrosity of metal and flesh. His body has been grotesquely augmented, with his legs and pelvis replaced by a hovering platform that allows him to float effortlessly through the battlefield. His once-human arms have been replaced by mechanical appendages, one adorned with a deadly saw blade and the other with a mighty chaingun that spits death at his foes.


It is said that The Daddy's massive frame is a result of the countless steroids and performance-enhancing drugs. His body is a twisted canvas of bulging veins and muscle fibers that writhe and pulse with an unnatural life.


And yet, for all his grotesquerie, The Daddy seems to revel in his own monstrous form. He wears a neon mohawk that pulses with electric light, a garish display of his own twisted style. And rumor has it that he's so obsessed with physical strength that he lifts weights made from the corpses of his fallen foes, a macabre display of his own monstrous power.


He is a creature of pure destruction. And he will stop at nothing to crush his foes and leave a trail of destruction in his wake.

That one annoying guy you never want to invite to a party... The standard military turret, although not fully assimilated by Syn, has been hacked and reprogrammed to be under the control of her armies. It serves as a stationary guard, relentlessly firing upon any living creature that comes within its range.

Weakness: Lock on Magnum shot, works every time...

Hovering menacingly in the air, the Security Drone packs a deadly pair of chainguns that it uses to take down any perceived threats. But what makes it truly disturbing is the fact that its central CPU has been replaced with a real, live human brain.


The Security Drone was once a trusted tool of the government in Paradise, used to protect the city's most important buildings from the criminals that infest its streets. But now, under the control of Syn and her Synified forces, it has become a twisted mockery of its former self.


The unfortunate human whose brain now powers the Security Drone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare, their thoughts and consciousness consumed by the machine that now houses them. They are no longer a living being, but a tool of Syn's relentless campaign of domination and destruction.


The Security Drone is a heartless killing machine, driven by a stolen human soul and ready to unleash destruction upon any who stand in its way.

Weakness: Go for the brain!

The Leaper is a hulking, blue gorilla-like creature with a TV for a head, crackling with electricity, and donning a creepily large smile. It can jump great distances and performs a powerful lunge attack that can knock the wind out of you. Its most devastating move is its electric-ring slam, which turns the arena into a 'the floor is lava' type scenario.


The Leaper is highly resistant to the Electro Blast shot from the Waster Shotgun. Legend has it that the Leaper was once a human, but was subjected to a twisted experiment that replaced its brain with a CPU and injected it with a powerful dose of electricity, turning it into the monstrous creature it is today. Its Synified creators used it as a test subject for their sick experiments, forcing it to leap through rings of fire while avoiding deadly obstacles, laughing at its misfortune.


Now, the Leaper roams the streets of Paradise, looking for its next victim to pummel with its electrified fists. Its wild, animalistic behavior and shocking appearance will strike fear into the hearts of even the bravest Street Cleaners, making it one of the most dangerous creatures in Paradise.

Weakness: Stay off the ground!

The Split's exosuit has completely consumed him, leaving behind only a twisted fusion of man and machine. His once-human form is now encased in layers of metal and circuitry, granting him superhuman strength and resilience. The exosuit's arms have been replaced with powerful cannons, each capable of unleashing a devastating array of projectiles.


The Split's attacks come in various forms, from circular plasma balls to rotating line projectiles that carve through anything in their path. He is a master of keeping his foes on their toes, unleashing a constant barrage of deadly firepower that can quickly overwhelm the unprepared.


The exosuit's mechanical tendrils snake their way into every part of the hosts body, creating a horrific amalgamation of man and machine that strikes fear into the hearts of all who face him.


Weakness: Take him down, and fast!

The Syn Mech is an ungodly sight to behold, a massive hulking blue machine that looms over everything in its path. Its driver has been completely entombed within its body, fused with the metal and circuits, becoming one with the machine. The driver is silent, calculating, and utterly devoted to the will of Syn.


The mech's arsenal is vast and devastating. Its mortar blast can flatten entire buildings, while its cluster grenades rain death from above. Its rocket launchers can obliterate anything in their path, and its shield charge can crush foes with ease.


Those who have faced the Syn Mech in battle speak of its relentless nature, and how it seems to shrug off even the most powerful attacks with ease. Some whisper that it is powered by the very essence of Syn herself, imbuing it with a dark power that makes it virtually unstoppable.

The Jacked Junkie is terrifying! His body is a twisted fusion of man and machine. As he charges towards you, his every step accompanied by anguished screams. His tentacle-like arms writhe and whip through the air, seeking to ensnare and strike at his victims.


Embedded within his torso is a massive television screen, displaying a disturbingly cheerful smiley face that adds an eerie contrast to the suffering and chaos surrounding him. The screen flickers with static, as if trying to convey his tortured existence.


The Jacked Junkie's relentless pursuit, fueled by his pain and madness, makes him an opponent not to be screwed with, especially when he hunts in packs. His screams reverberate through the air, haunting your every step as you try to evade his vicious attacks.

The Technopede is a nightmare-inducing machine, resembling a giant snake with six wiggly arms. Its mechanical head houses a devastating laser beam that can slice through steel like butter. Its body is armored and equipped with a missile launcher, which has the ability to track targets while the rockets are in flight.


In battle, the Technopede relies on two main attacks to take down its enemies. The first is a powerful charge beam that can incinerate anything in its path. The second is a deadly rocket barrage, which it unleashes from its missile launcher with deadly accuracy.


However, these attacks can be dodged by breaking line of sight with the Technopede, which is easier said than done. Its tall and imposing frame makes it hard to avoid, and its movements are unpredictable and erratic. Those who are unlucky enough to face the Technopede in battle would do well to tread carefully and stay alert at all times.


Weakness: Stun him with the Magnum lock on, then get up close for a clean blast.

As you engage in battle with the Sloth, you can't help but feel a sense of disgust and horror at the sight of this creature. His skin is stretched tight over his bloated body, and his organs seem to bulge and pulse beneath it. The glowing TV screen that serves as his head flickers with static, giving him an even more eerie appearance. Its massive body is supported by a mechanical platform with four twisted metal legs that scuttle and skitter across the ground with inhuman speed.


The Sloth's rocket launchers are grafted onto its flesh, jutting out like twisted bone spurs from its massive arms. Its belly cavity is a grotesque maw, and from within it emerges a fearsome minigun that spews hot lead in all directions.


As the Sloth takes aim with his rocket launchers, you can see the twisted screams on his face as he prepares to unleash destruction upon you.


The Sloth is not to be underestimated. He is heavily armored and can absorb a significant amount of damage before going down, but he is not invincible. It can be distracted and confused with clever tactics, and a fully charged Waster Electric Blast can stun it long enough for a strategic counterattack. Rockets and heavy weapons are also effective, but only if you can keep up with this abomination's lightning-fast movements.
